summary: Made Automatic, Prefixes only, and Off one authoritative runtime cache policy across lookup, creation, promotion, checkpoint persistence, and manual restore.
Made Automatic the new-install and missing-field migration default while preserving explicit legacy values.
Made Skill cache policy control stable Skill-prefix ownership and fingerprint edits by Skill identity, timestamp, and prompt content.
Removed the duplicate upstream preEncodeConversation control; it is derived from the native cache mode and verified by the contract gate.
Kept cache resource ceilings and compatibility fingerprints as compiled safety policy while exposing only the operational mode at runtime.

Proved with a real local GGUF that an exact Persona version reuses its prefix, Off suppresses reuse without deletion, a Persona edit invalidates reuse, and fresh processes restore encrypted prompt and conversation state.

tests_run.command: cargo test -p mom-llama-app && cargo clippy -p mom-llama-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
MOM_LLAMA_MODEL_PATH=<Hugging Face cached SmolLM2 GGUF> cargo test -p mom-llama-runtime --test runtime real_persona_mentions_reuse_only_the_exact_versioned_prefix -- --ignored
tests_run.detail: Proved first creation, exact-version reuse, authoritative Off behavior, and Persona-version invalidation with real in-process llama.cpp generation.
Proved authenticated fresh-process prompt-pack restore and automatic conversation-checkpoint reuse under the fixed 256 MiB/64-entry/2 GiB ceilings.
82 commands, 91 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 upstream settings, and zero blockers.

visual_acceptance.detail: Launched the debug macOS bundle, verified the restrained Developer > Prompt caching selector, switched to Off through Tauri UI and observed autosave, verified the persisted disabled policy, then restored Automatic and verified the persisted checkpoint marker.
